quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai
quotes.text: We had a strong quarter and are now on a half-trillion dollar revenue run rate. Our deep full stack approach is driving momentum across the business, with Alphabet revenues growing 25% year-over year.

quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai
quotes.text: Our AI investments are driving overall Search query growth, including commercial queries. In fact, our year-over-year query growth rate is the highest it's been in the last five years.

quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai
quotes.text: Google Cloud revenues grew 103%, powered by huge demand for our AI infrastructure and AI solutions. We're also seeing strong demand for our TPU systems across a wide range of customers.

quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai
quotes.text: Gemini 4 Argon and Carbon are now leading at the frontier. Overall, our first-party model APIs are now processing nearly 32 billion tokens per minute, more than four times what we processed a year ago.

quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai
quotes.text: On top of that, the Gemini app has reached one billion users—making it the fastest-growing product in Google's history—and we surpassed 150 million YouTube Music and Premium subscribers globally, including trials.

quotes.speaker: Sundar Pichai
quotes.text: We're excited by the range of big opportunities ahead of us.
